sources.sql:
CREATE TABLE "event" (
  "XCL_010" text,
  "XCL_011" text,
  "XCL_012" text,
  "XCL_013" text,
  "XCL_014" text,
  "XCL_015" text,
  "XCL_016" text
);

CREATE TABLE "zip_code" (
  "XCL_043" integer,
  "XCL_044" text,
  "XCL_045" text,
  "XCL_046" text,
  "XCL_047" text,
  "XCL_048" text
);

CREATE TABLE "budget" (
  "XCL_003" text,
  "XCL_004" text,
  "XCL_005" real,
  "XCL_006" real,
  "XCL_007" integer,
  "XCL_008" text,
  "XCL_009" text
);

CREATE TABLE "expense" (
  "XCL_017" text,
  "XCL_018" text,
  "XCL_019" text,
  "XCL_020" real,
  "XCL_021" text,
  "XCL_022" text,
  "XCL_023" text
);

CREATE TABLE "income" (
  "XCL_024" text,
  "XCL_025" text,
  "XCL_026" integer,
  "XCL_027" text,
  "XCL_028" text,
  "XCL_029" text
);

CREATE TABLE "member" (
  "XCL_034" text,
  "XCL_035" text,
  "XCL_036" text,
  "XCL_037" text,
  "XCL_038" text,
  "XCL_039" text,
  "XCL_040" text,
  "XCL_041" integer,
  "XCL_042" text
);

columns.retrieval_gloss: The 5-digit USPS postal code for a geographic area.
The classification of the zip code, such as Unique, Standard, or PO Box.
The city or town associated with the zip code.
The county or equivalent administrative division containing the zip code.
The full name of the state or territory where the zip code is located.

prediction.purpose: Stores geographic location information for US postal codes, including city, county, state, and type of zip code.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique identifier linking this attendance record to a specific event.
Unique identifier linking this attendance record to a specific member.

prediction.purpose: Records which members attended which events, linking members to events.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique identifier for each budget record.
Category or type of budgeted expense (e.g., Advertisement, Food).
Actual amount of money spent from the budget.
Amount of budget remaining after spending.
Total amount allocated or budgeted for this item.
Current status of the event or budget (e.g., Closed, Open, Planning).
Foreign key linking this budget record to a specific event.

prediction.purpose: Tracks budget allocations, spending, and remaining funds for club events and categories.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique identifier for each expense record.
Text description of what the expense was for.
Date when the expense occurred.
Monetary cost of the expense.
Whether the expense has been approved (true/false).
Foreign key linking to the member who submitted the expense.
Foreign key linking to the budget this expense is charged against.

prediction.purpose: Records each expense incurred by the student club, including description, date, cost, approval status, and links to the member who submitted it and the budget it belongs to.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique identifier for each income record.
The date when the income was received.
The monetary value of the income received.
The category or origin of the income (e.g., Dues, Fundraising).

observed_values: Secured donations to help pay for speaker gifts.

prediction.purpose: Records all monetary inflows to the student club, including dues, fundraising, school appropriations, and sponsorships.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique identifier for each member record.
The first name of the member.
The last name of the member.
The email address of the member.
The position or role held by the member in the club.
The t-shirt size of the member.
The phone number of the member.
The ZIP code of the member's address.
Foreign key linking to the major table to indicate the member's major.

prediction.purpose: Stores information about each member of the student club, including personal details, contact info, position, and links to major and zip code.
